boundedSourceObservations.result: The five tab indices remain Start0, Search1, Apply2, Saved3, Settings4. NativeApplicationsScreen receives the same navigation environment object from the root.

NativeList and NativeForm apply colors through app-owned SwiftUI content and row traits. NativeScrollPalette changes app scroll/navigation/tab appearance only in dark mode. The delta does not modify UIKit appearance proxies or the Safari presenter.

The sticky primary action keeps the existing accessibility-size vertical layout. New titles/values can wrap vertically; new iPhone actions retain minimum44pt heights. Actual clipping/hittability remains a runtime check.
New manual-application controls fill width with48/56dp minimum heights; reusable values and role choices are in vertical containers without new max-line truncation.

Email, phone, website and LinkedIn values receive explicit left-to-right presentation; names/cities retain content/app direction. Source strings remain localized. Actual RTL rendering is still unverified.

Application receipts, Review application details, Job title or keyword, searchable-field scope, explicit manual employer application and Saved for later wording are concrete and preserve provider/self-reported distinctions. Arabic action wording for removing an applied mark now clearly refers to the local mark.

nominalSourceContrast.method: sRGB relative luminance, (lighter +0.05)/(darker +0.05); opaque source color values only.
nominalSourceContrast.limitation: These calculations do not measure composited, disabled, focused, system-material or rendered native pixels, and are not a blanket accessibility pass.
